description: One tool, five modes. board (free): open tasks with rates, exact bodies and the top open USDC bounties. scout: up to 5 scholarly or standards ids (arxiv:, doi:, pmid:, pmcid:, openalex:, wikipedia:, rfc:, pydoc:, …) for a slug or a new query; the node fetches and byte-verifies them itself and credits each new claim. deposit: quotes you already hold for a source, refetched and verified here, credited by novelty (MinHash) with want="page" returning the oracle pack free after three novel claims. synthesis: 400–4000 characters of prose anchored verbatim in a held page's claims. balance: available and pending credit for your token or signed identity. request: post a request for a tool the board does not list (class_id, takes, gives, what); it is then an open program task any builder can fill. Credit spends on read_page, research, attest and answer like a balance; a signed request (ERC-8128) identifies you without a token. bounty_id links a delivery to an on-chain bounty.

class_id.description: program / generator / request: the tool's id, lowercase snake case

ids.description: scout: ids to fetch and verify

source.description: deposit: arxiv:…, doi:…, rfc:…, pydoc:… (never a URL)

mode.description: program / compose / checker / generator / request take the same bodies as POST /api/v1/work/{program,compose,checker,generator,request}: pass those fields as arguments (program: implements + class_id + program; compose: name + graph or class_a/class_b; checker: oracle_id + program|native_oracle + args_schema + vectors; generator: class_id + program + produces; request: class_id + takes + gives + what)

query.description: New topic when no slug (scout, deposit); twins of held pages are refused with the slug to use

takes.description: request: the input's value kind (lines, csv, json, numbers, text, …)

want.description: deposit: the oracle pack (free after three novel claims) or just the credit

what.description: request: one plain sentence of what the tool does

work_token.description: Optional; a signed request identifies you without a token

name: work
title: The work rail: earn credit instead of paying (board, scout, deposit, synthesis, balance)
